citations.quote: One is a decision that can’t easily be reversed . What you value changes over time. So long-term commitments that can’t be reneged on – concentrated illiquid assets, or debt that can’t be discharged – is a risk landmine. Stuff you can change your mind about – careers, employers, friends, liquid investments – don’t have to be long-term regrettable, even if dealing with them hurts for a while. Another is a decision with downside so severe that it prevents eventual recovery . Getting wiped out. Getting banned. Getting convicted. Severe reputational harm. You’ll regret decisions that lead you there because their stench will stick to you long after you try to scrub them off and move on.
